# Apex SEO /rent proxy
#
# Vercel rewrites (see vercel.json) reverse-proxy:
#   /rent/*  →  https://app.evorios.com/__seo/rent/*
#   /assets/*, /api/* (needed for the proxied SPA shell)
#
# Browser URL stays https://evorios.com/rent/... and returns 200.
# Canonical + sitemap live on this domain only.
# Keep sitemap.xml in sync with AllByRent scripts/seo/evorios-apex-sitemap.xml
# (regenerated by `npm run seo:sitemap` in the app repo).
#
# Locale marketing homepages (upload to AllByRent-Web root):
#   index.html          → https://evorios.com/          (en)
#   index-cs.html       → https://evorios.com/cs/
#   index-sk.html       → https://evorios.com/sk/
#   index-pl.html       → https://evorios.com/pl/
#   index-pt.html       → https://evorios.com/pt/
#   index-es-mx.html    → https://evorios.com/es-mx/
# vercel.json rewrites map /cs|/sk|/pl|/pt|/es-mx → those files
#   (/rent proxy rules stay first — no conflict).
# Auto phone-language redirect for apex `/` — paste
#   locale-auto-redirect.snippet.html into root index.html <head>
# Escape: https://evorios.com/?lang=en
